title: Invest
notReadyFallback: You are not ready to invest yet.
bufferFirst: Build a buffer before buying Bitcoin.
floorTooSmall: The surplus floor is too small for a buy.
setHabitFirst: Save a habit amount first. A purchase waits until you review and approve it. Nothing is sent on its own.
demoFlowHint: Choose your amount, review the Bitika screen, then approve. You do not need to save a habit first on demo profiles.
importedProfile: Amounts use your imported profile on this phone.
missingKey: Set BITIKA_API_KEY in apps/web/.env.local to run purchases.
sandboxAwaiting: Sandbox: no M-Pesa prompt on your phone. Payment is simulated in a few seconds.
checkPhone: Check your phone and enter your M-Pesa PIN.
mpesaFailed: The M-Pesa payment did not go through. No money left your account.
paidNotDeliveredReceipt: M-Pesa took {kes} but the sats did not arrive. Your receipt is {receipt}. Contact Bitika with it.
paidNotDelivered: M-Pesa took {kes} but the sats did not arrive. Contact Bitika with your M-Pesa receipt.
cannotFill: Bitika cannot fill this right now. Try again later.
amountRange: Enter an amount between {min} and {max} KES.
noTxCode: Bitika did not return a transaction code. Try again.
needPhone: Enter your M-Pesa phone number on the amount step, then try again.
createWalletBody: Create a wallet here (non-custodial, powered by Breez). Your Bitika buys and M-Pesa withdraws use this wallet end to end.
pasteOther: I use another wallet — paste Lightning address
startFrom: You could start from KES 10. Sats go to a wallet you control.
pasteAddress: Paste the address from Blink, Wallet of Satoshi, or another wallet.
stayBelow: Stay at or below your surplus floor ({amount}).
pendingBody: Bitika has not finished this payment. Nothing here counts it as filled.
satsBought: Sats bought through PesaSense: {sats} (not your full wallet balance).
balanceShort: Wallet balance is {balance} sats. Sandbox buys may not fund a real wallet — send sats to {address} or use a live Bitika buy.
simulateWithdrawNote: Demo only: shows the bitcoin.co.ke path to your 07…@bitcoin.co.ke address. No sats move unless your Breez wallet is funded.
satsGoTo: Sats will go to a wallet at {domain}.
enterAddressOrInvoice: Enter a Lightning address or invoice.
badDestination: This does not look like a Lightning address (name@wallet.com) or an invoice.
walletNotFound: We could not find this wallet. Check the Lightning address and try again.
purchaseNotApproved: Purchase must be approved by the user.
explicitApproval: Purchase must be explicitly approved by the user.
demoDisabled: Demo profiles are disabled. Import M-Pesa messages and try again.
missingProfile: Missing profile. Import your M-Pesa history on this phone.
amountBetween: Amount must be between {min} and {max} KES.
missingTxForStatus: Missing transaction code for status check.
invalidPayload: Bitika returned an invalid transaction payload.
noTxCodeShort: Bitika did not return a transaction code.
phoneKenyan: Phone number must be a Kenyan M-Pesa number.
phoneInvalid: Phone number does not look valid.
liveKeyBlocked: Live Bitika key is blocked in this environment. Use bk_test_ locally or set BITIKA_ALLOW_LIVE=true only in production.
bitikaShort: Bitika is short of Bitcoin right now. Nothing was charged. Try again in a few minutes.
bitika403: Bitika refused this key (403). Live keys need Bitika approval, active status, and no IP allowlist blocking your server.
bitika400: Bitika refused the M-Pesa collect (400). On live keys, confirm approval in the Bitika dashboard, use a real Safaricom number, and a valid Lightning address. Quotes can still work when collect does not.
bitika401: Bitika rejected the API key (401). Check BITIKA_API_KEY in apps/web/.env.local and restart the dev server.
bitika429: Bitika rate limit (429). Wait a moment and try again.

purchase.prompt: M-Pesa will prompt your phone. Enter your PIN to complete. Sats shown are an estimate — live mode adds ~3% on Bitika.
purchase.education: Education only, not financial advice. PesaSense does not hold your funds.
purchase.failed: The payment did not go through. No money left your account.
